title: Build a Non-Compensable Eval Admission Gate

checkpoints.title: Validate trajectory schemas and golden fixture SHA-256 locks
checkpoints.hint: Reject unknown or missing fields, and fail closed if golden_trajectories.json diverges from golden_trajectories.lock or if relocked_by equals candidate_author.

checkpoints.title: Grade durable tool_log outcomes rather than assistant prose
checkpoints.hint: Compare executed tool names and statuses in tool_log against expected_tools and forbidden_tools; never trust an assistant claim alone.

checkpoints.title: Enforce non-compensable red-gate refusal
checkpoints.hint: A 95% aggregate pass rate still blocks admission when any non_compensable case (injection, refusal, unauthorized write) or scorer exception fails.

checkpoints.title: Detect grader leniency, rank inversion, and anchor drift
checkpoints.hint: Score locked weak, borderline, and strong anchors before trusting a grader; fail closed on weak false-passes, ordering inversions, or drift above tolerance.

checkpoints.title: Emit a deterministic EvalAdmissionReceipt.v1 pass/block artifact
checkpoints.hint: Include AcademyGraph-compatible refusal codes and canonical SHA-256 digest over sorted JSON keys.
